purpose: Publish a bilingual plain-language 90-second, unitary and criminal-prosecutorial-first executive layer on the canonical 2011-2022 ACTA chronology, while preserving civil/horizontal-property, insolvency, title, operator, contrary-record and actor-specific proof controls.

actor_separation.rule: Act, capacity, duty, knowledge, purpose, reliance, effect and benefit/harm remain actor-specific; chronology, association or later benefit does not transfer culpability.

controlling_boundaries: The central mechanism is an attributed investigative hypothesis, not an adjudicated criminal finding.
Horizontal-property invalidity or irregularity does not by itself establish crime; formal civil or insolvency validity does not automatically exclude separate criminal relevance.
The incoming 2012 management team acknowledges that its early Community/maintenance-type charging method was incorrect; that mistake does not validate later contested authority and is not hidden.
The 1-Feb-2012 CEXP-Monterecco communication, AP 89/2014, AP 804/2018, the 26-Jun-2018 suspension, 24-Oct-2019 non-validation and 24-Feb-2021 reasoned decision remain visible counter-records.

The ONA-centred exit was developed; Gil Marer/Aweswell attribute its failure entirely to the 7-Jun-2018 material-control event and lack of effective judicial protection, while final facility, drawdown and the condition-performance ledger remain open.

20-Jan-2017 is a genuine definitive-text modification comparator; 8-Feb-2018 changes creditor identity, not the recognised credit; 4-Jun-2018 supplies a liquidation/payment calculation bridge, not a demonstrated definitive-text amendment.
The Mercantile Court response to the pre-7-Jun Arrecife request existed and was received on 11-Jun-2018; its content and annexes remain missing and are not reconstructed by inference.
Not located in the controlled corpus is not proof that a document or act did not exist.
Later title, works, finance or public support do not by themselves prove an earlier offence or a later actor's complicity.
No criminal judgment establishing the alleged plan or these actors' guilt has been located.
